name: wsl-config
description: Painel para gerenciar as distros do WSL: recursos, imagens, backups e configuração
author: Victor Alves Farias

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle && node desktop/run.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle && electron-builder --win
